spec_case: issue #627 (cache tokens sum across a prompt's own retries)
description: A json prompt with schema: and retries: {max_attempts: 2}: a decode-failed attempt then a succeeding one, both reporting cache reads/writes -- meta.attempts[] holds both, each with its own tokens_cached_in/tokens_cache_write, and the pass's own tokens_cached_in_total/tokens_cache_write_total sum both attempts.
